name: Kylox
description: Kidnapped by Krenko and accidentally killed.

description_citations.text: "The Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They find Kylox's workshop door unlocked, which is unusual.
timeline.quote: That's unusual. He never leaves the door unlocked.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: They find Kylox writing furiously in a hidden chamber.
timeline.quote: was a red viashino, facial scales reflecting the pallid light of the lantern on the desk's edge.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kylox reveals he was working on something secret and will only tell Ezrim.
timeline.quote: Something no one was meant to know.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Goblins chain and abduct Kylox as Proft and Etrata hide.
timeline.quote: The goblins produced thin lengths of mizzium chain, wrapping them around Kylox, who said nothing and only allowed himself to be taken.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: The goblin kidnappers carry Kylox to a pawnshop.
timeline.quote: the goblins carried Kylox to a disreputable-looking pawnshop.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Krenko interrogates Kylox about the killings out of fear for himself.
timeline.quote: I know enough to know I'm at risk here. You're going to tell me everything you know.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: A drugged attacker crashes in, kills Kylox, and is subdued by Etrata.
timeline.quote: There was a strangled gasp as the viashino fell out of the way and slid, motionless, to the floor.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba says she sent an assassin after Krenko and Kylox was in the way.
timeline.quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kylox is abducted by goblins and stabbed at Krenko's safehouse.
timeline.quote: a citizen burst into the window, bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft cracks Kylox's cryptex, learns of the Omenpath Project, and offers consulting to Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: Proft told the dragon that he knew about the project but would be willing to lend his skills to it for a consulting fee.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Goblins abduct Kylox from his laboratory; Etrata and Proft track them to Krenko's safehouse, where Etrata dispatches his minions and an enchanted citizen fatally stabs Kylox.
timeline.quote: a citizen burst into the window bound for Krenko and fatally stabbed Kylox

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fearing he is next after the murders of Zegana and Teysa, Krenko kidnaps Kylox but is thwarted by Proft and Etrata; a brainwashed citizen attacks and accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: accidentally killing Kylox first

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet devises the Omenpath Project and enlists guild representatives; Kylox is killed amid Oba's murders.
timeline.quote: The Firemind enlisted representatives from each of the guilds to research the portals and their passage.

citation.text: "Niv-Mizzet", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oba gets away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: Oba managed to get away with the murder of Teysa Karlov and accidentally killed Kylox .

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft raises Kylox's project, and reasons that Niv-Mizzet stood back because he was working on something larger than a few murders.
timeline.quote: the only reason you would stand back was because you were working on something bigger.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Alquist Proft investigates a string of murders and uncovers the Firemind's plans.
timeline.quote: Following a string of murders, including the death of one of Niv-Mizzet’s agents, Kylox , the detective Alquist Proft began investigating evidence that uncovered the Firemind’s plans.

citation.text: "Omenpath", section "Ravnica and the Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kylox is enlisted by Ezrim for a secret project and moves it to a secret tunnel after his lab is ransacked by Krenko's underlings.
timeline.quote: Kylox was enlisted by the archon Ezrim for a project he was to keep secret

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata ask Kylox to research a substance; he refuses without a promise of safety.
timeline.quote: Kylox turned them down unless they could promise him safety

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Krenko's minions kidnap Kylox; Proft and Etrata free him but a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: he was accidentally killed by a brainwashed assassin sent to kill Krenko

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the mastermind; Oba justifies Kylox's killing by his Phyrexian technology work.
timeline.quote: she justified Kylox's killing by blaming his work with Phyrexian technology

citation.text: "Kylox", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Massacre Girl tries to kill Proft but Etrata stops her; Krenko kidnaps Kylox, who is accidentally killed.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl attempted to assassinate Proft but was stopped by Etrata

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Alquist, thank you. I hoped you'd understand what I was asking for.
